text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the shopping street on an errand,
Haru Urara was strolling along, humming to herself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the shopping district gave me a present saying, "Keep up the good work!"
Isn't that amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It used to be "Don't push yourself,"
but now it's "You're working hard!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "I think it's definitely because I've gotten waaaay better at running than before!"
I promised Haru Urara that we'd keep doing our best together from now on.
